items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: we had Peanuts Halland with us.

ctx.x: Now, getting back to me while I was in the band, just one thing to end this up, this era in the Aquarium -- that was when we were talking before, and I don't know whether it's on tape, about Charlie Shavers, he got the offer then to go with Tommy Dorsey, and he left John after helping him out as many days as he could -- he went and joined Tommy Dorsey; I don't know whether he was at the Pennsylvania Hotel or not, and he had seen that John got straightened out and gotten on his feet, so he sent Dizzy in, if you…
